```{julia}
const DIR_PRJ = string(strip(read(`git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, String)))
using Pkg
Pkg.activate(DIR_PRJ)
```

```{julia}
using CSV, DataFrames, TidierData
using XLSX: XLSX, readtable, openxlsx, writetable!
```

# Series

```{julia}
tbl_template = @chain CSV.read(
  joinpath(DIR_PRJ, "data", "provided", "tbl_template.tsv"),
  DataFrame
  ) begin
  @mutate(line = ~eachindex(industry))
  @mutate(level = length.(getproperty.(match(r"\s*", industry), :match)) ÷ 4)
  @mutate(level = if_else(account == "GDP", -1, level))
end
```

```{julia}
flows = CSV.read(
  joinpath(DIR_PRJ, "data", "flow.tsv"),
  DataFrame
)
```

```{julia}
tbl = @chain tbl_template begin
  @inner_join(
    @chain flows begin
      @select(account, year, value = gfcf)
      dropmissing!
    end
  )
  @pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = value,
  )
  @right_join(tbl_template)
  @arrange(line)
end
k = Cols(contains(r"^\d{4}$"))
for i in nrow(tbl):-1:1
  if ismissing(tbl[i, end])
    lvl = tbl[i, :level]
    idx_max = something(
      findfirst(≤(lvl), tbl[i + 1:end, :level]),
      length(tbl[i + 1:end, :level]) + 1
    ) + i - 1
    candidates = findall(isequal(lvl + 1), tbl[!, :level])
    filter!(∈(i:idx_max), candidates)
    tbl[i, k] = sum(Matrix(tbl[candidates, k]), dims = 1)
  end
end
```

```{julia}
CSV.write(
  joinpath(DIR_PRJ, "data", "pub_tbl_gfcf.tsv"),
  tbl,
  delim = '\t'
)
```
